news.headline: Questionable (Shoulder)
news.detail: Mumpfield briefly exited the game before returning to the field, and head coach Sean McVay and the team don't appear to be overly worried about the injury. With Puka Nacua returning to action Sunday, Mumpfield saw only three targets, reeling in one catch for seven yards in the victory.

profile: role: WR4 rotational — 9% of targets, 48% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
